By default the plan is drawn as the audience sees it, with the audience at the bottom. In

you can draw it as the choir and conductor see it instead, with the audience at the top. You can also choose how chairs are labelled (like B-7): letters or numbers, and which corner is 1. Only the drawing turns; nobody moves. A printed plan shows the audience bar on the side the audience is, and a spreadsheet export names the viewpoint in its first line.
